content.text:
**Finding submitted: missing behaviour (high severity).**

Section 9 grants termination only for material breach (9.1), insolvency (9.2), and specified Vendor failures (9.3), and jumps from 9.3 to 9.5 — there is no convenience right for either party. Combined with the three-year term in 8.1 and 180-day non-renewal notice in 8.2, we have no exit path, which the playbook treats as a deviation for terms over 12 months.

Redline (validated, preferred level): inserted a new 9.4 giving Customer a 30-day convenience right, in whole or in part, without penalty or early-termination charge, with refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, and expressly confirming Vendor has no mid-term convenience right. No deletions were required — Sections 7 and 10 contain no wind-down or early-termination charges, and 10.2 already supports the pro-rata refund mechanic.
